# text (R package)

> The text-package (r-text.org) analyzes human language in R using transformer
> language models from Hugging Face, NLP and machine learning. Core workflow:
> transform text to word embeddings with textEmbed(), then train/predict with
> textTrain()/textPredict(), test differences with textSimilarity(), and
> visualize with textProjection()/textPlot(). Models run locally (except
> textLLM(), which calls external LLM APIs). Companion packages: topics
> (r-topics.org) for topic modeling; talk (r-talk.org) for voice recordings.

## Setup (always required once)

- [Installation guide](https://r-text.org/installation.html): install.packages("text"); library(text); textrpp_install(); textrpp_initialize(save_profile = TRUE). The package needs a Python environment (created by textrpp_install()); textDiagnostics() helps when setup fails.
- [Try in browser (Colab)](https://r-text.org/installation.html): run text without installing anything.

## Core workflow

- [textEmbed](https://r-text.org/reference/textEmbed.html): transform text to word embeddings (contextual, from transformer models). Example: word_embeddings <- textEmbed(Language_based_assessment_data_8[, c("harmonywords")]).
- [textTrain](https://r-text.org/reference/textTrain.html): train a (ridge regression) model predicting a numeric/categorical variable from embeddings; returns cross-validated correlations.
- [textPredict](https://r-text.org/reference/textPredict.html): apply trained or pre-trained models (from the L-BAM library) to new texts.
- [textSimilarity](https://r-text.org/reference/textSimilarity.html): semantic similarity between two sets of texts.
- [textDescriptives](https://r-text.org/reference/textDescriptives.html): word counts and descriptive statistics of text.

## Visualization

- [textProjection](https://r-text.org/reference/textProjection.html): supervised dimension projection of words onto a psychological dimension; null_method "token" or "participant".
- [textPlot](https://r-text.org/reference/textPlot.html): word-cloud style plots of projections, centrality and PCA.
- [Visualization tutorial](https://r-text.org/articles/visualizations.html): full paper with runnable code and figures.

## Language tasks (local Hugging Face pipelines)

- [textZeroShot](https://r-text.org/reference/textZeroShot.html): zero-shot classification with custom labels (e.g., sentiment) — no training data needed.
- [textClassify](https://r-text.org/reference/textClassify.html): apply trained or pre-trained (L-BAM) classification models to texts.
- [textGeneration](https://r-text.org/reference/textGeneration.html), [textSum](https://r-text.org/reference/textSum.html), [textQA](https://r-text.org/reference/textQA.html), [textTranslate](https://r-text.org/reference/textTranslate.html), [textNER](https://r-text.org/reference/textNER.html).

## LLM APIs (data leaves the machine)

- [textLLM](https://r-text.org/reference/textLLM.html): send texts/prompts to OpenAI-compatible APIs for annotation and labelling; requires the user's own API key (OPENAI_API_KEY); asks for third-party-sharing confirmation in interactive sessions.

## Topics and training

- [textTopics](https://r-text.org/reference/textTopics.html): BERTopic modeling with tests against outcome variables.
- [textFineTune](https://r-text.org/reference/textFineTune.html): fine-tune transformer models.
- [L-BAM library](https://r-text.org/articles/LBAM.html): pre-trained language-based assessment models for textPredict().

## Key guidance for code generation

- Always start sessions with library(text); first-time setup needs textrpp_install() then textrpp_initialize(save_profile = TRUE).
- Built-in example data: Language_based_assessment_data_8 (40 participants; text columns such as harmonywords, satisfactionwords; numeric scales such as hilstotal, swlstotal).
- textEmbed() is the slow step: advise users to save embeddings with saveRDS() and reuse them.
- Functions return tibbles; settings are stored in comment() of the returned object.
- Reference index: https://r-text.org/reference/index.html. Tutorial paper: https://r-text.org/articles/text.html.
